Redrawing the frames against a run that reproduces the one they used would move a frozen sample for no gain (ticket 09: inference may repeat, measurement may not), so this edge names the run the draw recorded and that run is walked beside the published one

LINEAGE_RECORDED_PIN edge=theme_labels_llm<-theme_samples.samples reason=theme_samples draws one frame per run -- discovery, development, audit, training_pool -- so several of its outputs are live at once and the latest is not the right one for any particular labelling run. LINEAGE_RECORDED_PIN edge=theme_labels_reference<-theme_samples.samples reason=the reference labels are written blind against one frame (RR-21); like the labeller's edge above, the frame it read is the run it recorded, not whichever frame was drawn last
